title: Initialize a Tote Using the Initialize Tote Aveva API Page
summary: Use the Aveva API “Initialize Tote” page to initialize a tote for processing by entering BarcodeID/Code ID, StationID, and ToteID, submitting the request, and reading the on-screen Response field for confirmation or error/tote status (including AGV-related rejection conditions).
when_to_use: When you need to initialize a tote in the system using the Aveva API “Initialize Tote” page and you must verify success/failure from the Response field.
not_for: Do not proceed with additional configuration changes based only on the training segment; rely on the Response field’s error/tote status text to determine what happened.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Aveva API “Initialize Tote” request by entering BarcodeID/Code ID, StationID, and ToteID, then submit and interpret the Response field (confirmation vs error/tote status).
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the “Initialize Tote Aveva API” page (Aveva API interface)
Ability to view and enter fields: BarcodeID, Code ID, StationID, ToteID
Ability to click “Request to Initialize Tote” and read the “Response” field

access_required: Access to the “Initialize Tote Aveva API” page
system_preconditions: You have the tote number/barcode value to enter into BarcodeID and Code ID
You know the StationID value for the rack/station (as referenced in RMS)

visual_references.description: Initialize Tote Aveva API page showing input fields (BarcodeID, StationID, ToteID), the “Request to Initialize Tote” button, and the “Response” field behavior.

steps.title: Open the “Initialize Tote Aveva API” page
steps.purpose: Access the interface used to initialize a tote and view the Response field.
steps.instruction: Navigate to and open the Aveva API “Initialize Tote” page that contains the BarcodeID, StationID, ToteID fields, the “Request to Initialize Tote” button, and the “Response” field.
steps.expected_result: The page loads and shows the input fields (BarcodeID, StationID, ToteID) and the “Request to Initialize Tote” button, with a visible “Response” field area.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the “Request to Initialize Tote” button and the “Response” field on the page.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load or the “Response” field/button are not visible, preventing you from submitting and reading results.

actions.label: Open Initialize Tote Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the “Initialize Tote Aveva API” page

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page does not load or the “Response” field is not visible, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript describe the “Initialize Tote Aveva API page” with form fields (BarcodeID, StationID, ToteID), a “Request to Initialize Tote” button, and a “Response” field that displays confirmation or error.

steps.title: Enter the tote number into the BarcodeID field
steps.purpose: Provide the tote identifier required by the Initialize Tote request.
steps.instruction: In the “BarcodeID” field, enter the tote’s barcode/tote number.
steps.expected_result: The “BarcodeID” field contains the tote number you intend to initialize.
steps.healthy_condition: BarcodeID field is populated with the intended tote number value.
steps.failure_condition: BarcodeID is blank or contains an incorrect value (leading to an error/tote status in the Response field after submission).

actions.label: Verify BarcodeID field
actions.exact_action: Enter the tote’s barcode/tote number into the BarcodeID field

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot determine the correct tote number for BarcodeID, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “you add a barcode or the tote number…”. OCR lists “BarcodelD” as a key input field.

steps.title: Enter the same number into the Code ID field
steps.purpose: Ensure Code ID matches BarcodeID as required by the interface.
steps.instruction: If the page includes a “Code ID” field, enter the same tote number value you used for BarcodeID.
steps.expected_result: The “Code ID” field (if present) contains the same number as “BarcodeID”.
steps.failure_condition: Code ID differs from BarcodeID (may cause initialization failure reflected in the Response field).

actions.label: Populate Code ID to match BarcodeID
actions.exact_action: Enter the same number into the Code ID field (if present) as BarcodeID

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page does not show a Code ID field, proceed with the remaining required fields (StationID and ToteID).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “for barcode and code ID just same number.”

steps.title: Enter the StationID value
steps.purpose: Specify the station on the rack where the tote should be initialized for processing.
steps.instruction: In the “StationID” field, enter the StationID value for the rack/station (the source indicates StationID is shown in RMS).
steps.expected_result: The “StationID” field contains the correct station ID value.
steps.healthy_condition: StationID matches the station you intend to initialize the tote for (as referenced from RMS station ID).
steps.failure_condition: StationID is incorrect or unknown, which can result in an error/tote status in the Response field after submission.
stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot determine the correct StationID, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “station ID is what stations on the rack or like we showed station ID in RMS.” OCR lists “StationID” as a key input field.

steps.title: Enter the ToteID value
steps.purpose: Provide the tote identifier required by the Initialize Tote request.
steps.instruction: In the “ToteID” field, enter the ToteID value for the tote you are initializing.
steps.expected_result: The “ToteID” field contains the tote ID value.
steps.healthy_condition: ToteID is populated with the intended tote identifier.
steps.failure_condition: ToteID is blank or incorrect, leading to an error/tote status in the Response field after submission.
stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot determine the correct ToteID, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “add a barcode or the tote number and then the station and then the tote ID.” OCR lists “TotelD” as a key input field.

steps.title: Click “Request to Initialize Tote”
steps.purpose: Send the initialization command to the system using the provided details.
steps.instruction: Click the “Request to Initialize Tote” button to submit the initialization request.
steps.expected_result: The system processes the request and updates the “Response” field with a confirmation message or an error message/tote status.
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking, the Response field updates (no longer blank) with a result.
steps.failure_condition: The Response field does not update or does not provide a clear error/tote status.

actions.label: Submit initialization request
actions.exact_action: Click the “Request to Initialize Tote” button

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Response field does not provide a clear error/tote status, stop and escalate.
If you cannot determine whether the failure is due to AGV-related conditions described by the source, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “Request to Initialize Tote” button sends a command; system processes request and displays the response in the “Response” field. Transcript: “click request to initialize tote the response.”

steps.title: Observe the “Response” field after the request completes
steps.purpose: Confirm whether initialization succeeded or failed, and capture the error/tote status text for troubleshooting interpretation.
steps.instruction: After the request completes, read the “Response” field to determine whether initialization succeeded (confirmation) or failed (error message and/or tote status).
steps.expected_result: Response field shows either: (a) a confirmation message for success, or (b) an error message and/or tote status explaining why initialization failed.
steps.healthy_condition: Response field clearly indicates success with a confirmation message, or clearly indicates failure with an error message and/or tote status text.
steps.failure_condition: Response field is unclear, blank, or does not provide enough information to determine the failure cause.

actions.label: Read Response field
actions.exact_action: Observe the “Response” field after the request completes

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the Response field does not provide a clear error/tote status.
Do not proceed with additional configuration changes based only on the training segment; rely on the Response field’s error/tote status text.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: Response field shows confirmation if successful; shows an error message if initialization fails. Transcript: “it’ll give you a response saying it can’t be initialized… it’ll give you a tote status of why it wasn’t initialized.”

steps.title: Interpret AGV-related rejection and tote status from the Response field
steps.purpose: Use the Response field’s tote status text to determine whether the failure is related to AGV conditions described by the source.
steps.instruction: If the Response indicates initialization cannot be done, interpret the Response/tote status text using the AGV-related conditions described: totes on an AGV may be rejected; only AGVs not in the system or AGVs that have been removed are referenced as conditions that lead to a “can’t be initialized” response and a tote status explaining why.
steps.expected_result: When initialization fails, the Response field includes an error message and/or tote status text that indicates the reason, including AGV-related conditions (e.g., tote on an AGV rejection; AGV not in the system or removed AGV conditions).
steps.healthy_condition: Response field provides a tote status that clearly explains why initialization wasn’t done, including the AGV-related condition referenced by the source.
steps.failure_condition: Response field does not provide clear tote status text, or you cannot determine whether the failure is due to the AGV-related conditions described.

actions.label: Interpret tote status text
actions.exact_action: Interpret the source-backed causes from the Response field (AGV-related rejection and removed/not-in-system AGV conditions)

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the Response field does not provide a clear error/tote status.
Stop and escalate if you cannot determine whether the failure is due to AGV-related conditions described by the source.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “Let’s say the totes are on AGV, it’ll give you a response saying it can’t be initialized… Only Agvs not in the system or Agvs that have been removed… it’ll give you a tote status of why it wasn’t initialized.”

success_criteria: Response field shows a confirmation message indicating the tote initialization request succeeded.
healthy_conditions: Response field updates after submission and clearly indicates either success (confirmation) or failure (error message and/or tote status).
failure_conditions: Response field does not provide a clear error/tote status.

Response field indicates initialization cannot be done due to AGV-related conditions (totes on an AGV rejection; AGV not in the system or removed AGV conditions) and the tote status text does not clearly explain the reason.
escalation_guidance: If the Response field does not provide a clear error/tote status, stop and escalate.
If you cannot determine whether the failure is due to AGV-related conditions described by the source, stop and escalate.
When escalating, include the exact text shown in the Response field (confirmation vs error/tote status).
